entries.german:
Abt Heinrich von St. Gallen überträgt dem Portneramt anstelle veräusserter Einkünfte solche aus einer Klostermühle.

H. dei gratia abbas monasterii sancti Galli 1 omnibus presentium inspectoribus salutem cum noticia subscriptorum. Noverint igitur || universi, quos nosce fuerit oportunum, quod nos officio portenarii in nostro monasterio redditus duarum librarum et II quinque solidorum in beneficiis claustralibus, quandocumque se obtulerit facultas, refundere tenemur, in recompensam || videlicet duarum librarum, quas Egl. de Rosinberg 2 miles b) recipit de curia in Bernanc 3, que predicto officio portenarii est annexa, et in recompensam quinque solidorum, qui dabantur singulis annis hactenus eidem officio de molendino sito sub rupibus dicto an dem Werde 4, quod de cetera fieri non debet. Et ne prelibatum officium in suis redditibus defectum penitus paciatur, nos prefatus H. abbas pro nobis nostrisque successoribus, qui pro tempore fuerint, donamus et presentibus donasse profitemur eidem officio redditus quindecim solidorum de molendino monasterii nostri dicto Vndir dem Steine 5, cuius cultor V olr. dictus Muslinger iam esse dinoscitur, singulis annis recipiendos, quousque per nos vel per nostros successores prelibato officio redditus duarum librarum et quinque solidorum, prout superius notatum est, refundentur. In cuius rei testimonium presentem litteram eidem officio tradimus nostri sigilli robore communitam. Dat. apud sanctum Gallum, anno domini M.CCC septimo, VIII. kl. maii, indic. V. presentibus hon(orabili) viro Hermanno de Landinberg 6 rectore ecclesie in Berotswille 7, Walt, capellano nostro 8 rectore ecclesie in Heriso vwe 9, R. sculteto nostro in Wila 10, C. ministro in Abbatiscella 11 et H. de Teiningen 12 aliisque fidedignis.

Siegel: Siegel abh., fehlt.
entries.english:
Abbot Heinrich of St. Gallen assigns revenues from a monastery mill to the office of porter in place of revenues that have been alienated.

H., by God's grace abbot of the monastery of St. Gallen, wishes salvation and knowledge of the following to all who inspect this document. Let all who need to know understand that we are bound to restore to the office of porter in our monastery revenues of two pounds and five shillings from monastic benefices whenever the opportunity arises, as compensation for the two pounds which Egilolf von Rosenberg, Ritter, receives from the estate at Berneck attached to the said office of porter, and for the five shillings which until now have been given each year to that office from the mill situated below the cliffs called am Werde, which is no longer to be done. So that the aforesaid office does not suffer a complete shortfall in its revenues, we, the aforesaid Abbot H., for ourselves and our successors in office, give and hereby declare that we have given to that office annual revenues of fifteen shillings from our monastery's mill called Unter dem Stein, whose operator is known to be Volrich called Muslinger, to be received each year until we or our successors restore to the aforesaid office the revenues of two pounds and five shillings, as specified above. In witness of this we deliver this letter to that office, confirmed by the strength of our seal. Issued at St. Gallen in the year of the Lord 1307, on the eighth day before the Kalends of May, in the fifth indiction. Present were the honorable Hermann of Landenberg, rector of the church at Beretswil; Walt, our chaplain and rector of the church at Herisau; R., our reeve at Wil; C., minister at Appenzell; H. of Tanningen; and other trustworthy people.

Seal: detached and missing.
